title: Ananke WorldControl
description: The ultimate, lightweight tool for granular control over Minecraft physics, player stats, mob griefing, and crafting. Block anything, anywhere.
body:
🌍 Ananke WorldControl

Take absolute command over your Minecraft world.

Ananke WorldControl is a high-performance, granular world management plugin designed for server owners who need precise control without the bloat. From disabling specific crafting recipes to stopping Endermen from stealing blocks, Ananke gives you the power to shape your server's mechanics exactly how you want them. --- ### 🔥 Key Features #### 🛡️ Granular Block & Item Control * **Block anything**: Disable placement, breaking, or interaction for any block in the game. * **Custom Block Support**: Seamless integration with **Oraxen**, **Nexo**, and **ItemsAdder**. * **Global Interaction Blocker**: Disable chest/container access or flint-and-steel usage server-wide. #### ⚒️ Crafting & Economy Mastery * **Auto-Populated Crafting**: Automatically scans and populates all 1,000+ recipes in `crafting.yml` on first run—no manual setup required. * **Item-by-Item Crafting**: Block specific armor, tools, or items from being crafted while leaving others enabled. * **Granular Smelting**: Control exactly what can be cooked in furnaces, smokers, and blast furnaces. #### ⚛️ Physics & Environment Mastery * **Explosion Control**: Disable block damage or neutralize knockback while keeping the damage. * **Fluid Logistics**: Prevent infinite water sources, fluid mixing (obsidian/cobble farms), or waterlogging. * **Mechanical Persistence**: Lock the world time, keep farmland moist, and prevent crop trampling. * **Rotation Control**: Block **Debug Stick** usage and force default orientations on placement. #### 🧟 Mob & Griefing Prevention * **Anti-Grief**: Stop Endermen, Villagers, Sheep, and Ravagers from altering your terrain. * **Spawn Control**: Granularly toggle spawning for any mob type or entire categories (Monsters, Passive, Water). * **Explosion Safety**: Control block damage for Creepers, TNT, Withers, and Ghasts individually. #### 👤 Player Stat Toggles * **Survival Perks**: Toggle fall damage and hunger loss. * **Void Protection**: Automatically teleport falling players back to spawn. * **Regeneration Control**: Disable natural health regeneration to create a hardcore experience. --- ### ⚙️ Why choose Ananke? * **"Idiot-Proof" Config**: Cleanly organized sections (`ENVIRONMENT`, `PHYSICS`, `PLAYERS`, etc.) with helpful comments. * **Lightweight**: Optimized event handling ensures zero server lag. * **Admin Friendly**: In-game command `/awc feature ` allows for real-time adjustments. * **Permission Ready**: Full support for bypass permissions (`ananke.worldcontrol.bypass`). --- ### 📜 Commands & Permissions * `/awc reload` - Reload configuration. * `/awc feature ` - Toggle world mechanics. * `/awc craft ` - Toggle specific item crafting. * `/awc block ` - Toggle block placement/breaking. * **Permission**: `ananke.worldcontrol.admin`
